stories.title: ‘I thought I died’: Survivor of deadly Tsawwassen Mills crash on long road to recovery
stories.summary: B.C. freelance videographer Kevin Li was setting up his equipment at Tsawwassen Mills Mall on Truth and Reconciliation Day, Sept. 30.

stories.title: Indian national gets more than 19 years in prison over plot to kill Sikh leader
stories.summary: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty earlier this year to charges related to a murder-for-hire scheme for attempting to kill Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

stories.title: Recipe: White Spot’s best everyday mashed potatoes
stories.summary: Here are a few simple tricks from White Spot's executive chef on how to turn everyday mashed potatoes into something special, along with a go-to recipe that's sure to please.

stories.title: Lorne Doerkson becomes B.C.’s 38th premier, announces cabinet positions
stories.summary: British Columbia's first Conservative government in almost a century will take the reins of power when Lorne Doerkson becomes premier and unveils his first cabinet.

stories.title: 5 Mission teens arrested after video posted online of another swarming attack
stories.summary: Police say assault charges have been recommended against all five youths -- including some who allegedly encouraged the attack rather than physically participating.

stories.title: Man from India accused of kidnapping, sexual assault of woman held hostage in Airdrie
stories.summary: A man from India, in Canada on a visitor visa, has been charged with sexual assault, kidnapping and more after being arrested during a hostage standoff north of Calgary.

stories.title: B.C. woman who travelled to Syria to marry ISIS supporter says she realizes it was a mistake
stories.summary: That admission was in a letter Kimberly Polman wrote that's part of the agreed statement of facts filed in her case that a Vancouver judge will consider in her upcoming sentencing.

stories.title: Vancouver landlords fined $90K now facing prosecution over West Side property
stories.summary: B.C.'s Residential Tenancy Branch recently fined the landlords $90,000 for subdividing an East Vancouver home into 21 sleeping rooms, with at least 17 tenants.

stories.title: BC Nurses’ Union says arbitration in labour dispute has ended
stories.summary: Members spent three weeks on picket lines this summer, and while some items were resolved through mediation, other compensation issues went to binding arbitration.

stories.title: 7-Eleven owners in Vernon fined $300K by WorkSafeBC
stories.summary: Documents show that employees reported multiple robberies this year alone, with coffee being thrown at them and verbal threats from customers.
